en: Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate spa building with a central pavilion and arched colonnades extending to both sides, set behind a formal garden with manicured shrubs, flowerbeds, and paths. The architecture is grand and symmetrical with a high roof crowned by decorative finials and crosses. On the upper left is printed the place name "Bad Elster." On the upper right appears the text "Kgl. Kurhaus."
